name: Ingest Documents
description: Use to add a file or a folder of documents into JARVIS's searchable document memory, so questions can later be answered from them. Supports .txt, .md, .json, .csv and .log. Required parameter: path (string file or folder path inside the project workspace). Returns an ingestion summary. DO NOT use to read a single file for immediate display (use read_file).

path.description: File or folder path to ingest. Must be inside the project workspace.
